name: 993 front impact support, AlSi10Mg load-path (bionic) concept (PicoGK)
picogk_enhancement: Bionic: the support between the 3 mm rear plate and a 60 x 38 mm bumper-beam contact pad is grown by 3D SIMP topology optimization (source/bionic.json, topopt.py; 3.125 mm elements, 13 % of the FVD 139 x 100 x 53 mm envelope) under the synthetic 15 kN mean crush force of evidence/engineering-screen.json, axial, +/-15 deg oblique in plan and 10 deg downward on the upper half of the pad (assumed directions), then smoothed into branching struts by PicoGK (about 223 g in AlSi10Mg vs the 145 g FVD claim) with the plate and pad fused exactly. Compliance minimisation gives a stiff static load path, not a crush or energy-absorption design: folding, force-displacement and crash behaviour are NOT modelled. Loads and interfaces are assumptions until measured.
